'''2011 German National Championship Joerg Rautenberg DS Tatooine: Desert Landing Site''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joerg Rautenberg]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Desert Landing Site|Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' PD11 - Dark Side The Sith Try It Again
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
